Everything works. Here's what was implemented:

### Files created/modified

| File | Purpose |
|------|---------|
| `TicketClassifier.csproj` | Added `Microsoft.ML 4.0.2` package |
| `Models/TicketData.cs` | ML.NET data model + prediction output class |
| `Models/TicketRequest.cs` | API DTOs: `TicketRequest`, `PredictionResponse`, `EvaluationMetrics` |
| `Services/TicketClassifierService.cs` | Trains SDCA Maximum Entropy model on startup using text featurization of Subject + Description + Priority |
| `Controllers/TicketController.cs` | Two endpoints below |
| `Program.cs` | Registers the classifier as a singleton |

### Endpoints

- **`POST /api/ticket/predict`** — Takes `{subject, description, priority}`, returns predicted category + per-class confidence scores
- **`GET /api/ticket/metrics`** — Returns macro/micro accuracy, log loss, and per-class precision/recall/F1

The model uses text featurization on Subject and Description, concatenated with Priority, then normalizes and trains with SDCA Maximum Entropy. Label key ordering is extracted dynamically from the trained model so confidence scores always align correctly.
